categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches Wallet label and modifies transaction creation validation in src/wallet/spend.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents integer overflow, node assertion crashes, and generation of invalid transactions when spending amounts exceeding MAX_MONEY. As noted in the description, funding transactions with extreme recipient sums can cause 'Assertion failed: (!m_selected_inputs.empty()), function RecalculateWaste' or wrap around to allow funding outputs of impossible amounts.
